videos.title: Understanding Inequalities & Their Graphs
videos.description: In this video lesson we will learn how to graph an inequality using an open or closed circle and an arrow.  We will learn that the open circle represents less than or greater than since the value is NOT part of the solution set.  We will learn that a closed circle is used to represent greater than or equal to and less than or equal to.  We will graph inequalities and we will write inequalities from graphs.  We will also determine if a value is a solution of an inequality.  Student Practice is embedded in the lesson with modeled exemplar solutions.
